recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit. Do not reintroduce TestScript source in core for FHIR-27007; handle any future TestScript.scope refinement in HL7/fhir-testing-ig.
issue_request: FHIR-27007 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by FHIR-I. It requested a way for TestScript to identify the conformance or implementation artifacts under test, with the final disposition adding TestScript.scope after metadata using artifact canonical(Any), conformance CodeableConcept, and phase CodeableConcept children.
initial_application: Core commits bd6381b4ffae4b45c6397dbfc952ec02418c418b, c723b0637f2c5455d61d0e18f9593afbb59ffdd2b, and b8bb7165976d1a1485320b9641e238733fdbbbba applied the issue while TestScript was active in core by adding TestScript.scope, terminology, OIDs, and the scope search-parameter family under source/testscript.
additional_context: Later FHIR-32689 refined scope.conformance codes, and FHIR-41254 fixed related scope search parameters. Current core no longer has source/testscript: commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed the testing resources from core build scope and added the FHIR Testing IG pointer. Current core fhir.ini and ballot-intro link TestScript to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/fhir-testing-ig, and existing combined-branch audits for FHIR-27533, FHIR-32689, FHIR-36211, FHIR-41254, and FHIR-46100 document the same external ownership.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The current HL7/fhir-testing-ig source contains TestScript.scope, scope.artifact canonical, scope.conformance CodeableConcept, scope.phase CodeableConcept, and the related scope search parameters, so the remaining ownership for this issue is external to the FHIR core checkout.
